title: ר' שמעון בן יעקב דמן צור
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Yaakov of Tyre asked R' Yohanan before R' Binyamin bar Yefet: Berakhot 33a; see there. R' Avahu said, “R' Yishmael ben Yaakov of Tyre asked R' Yohanan in Tzidon, and I heard”: Ketubbot 7a. Perhaps one is a scribal error.
